in_arabic.name: هُدَايَة
in_arabic.meaning: هُدَايَةُ: الهداية المقدسة، الطريق المشرق، الإشراف
in_arabic.long_meaning: هُدَايَةُ: هي الطريق المشرق الذي يؤدي إلى العبودية، وتعني الإشراف الذي يعطي الله للمؤمنين. وهي مُشتقة من الاسم الفاعل هُدي، والذي يعني الرشاد، والإرشاد، والهداية. تعود أصولها إلى الجذر هَداَاةُ، والذي يتضمن المعنيين الرشد والهداية. وتؤكد التسمية هُدَايَةُ على دور الإسلام في هداية البشر، وتشير إلى أن الإسلام هو الطريق الحق الذي يؤدي إلى العبودية والخلود في الجنة.

in_english.name: Hudaayah
in_english.meaning: Hudaayah: Divine guidance, right path, illumination, enlightenment
in_english.long_meaning: Hudaayah: This name signifies divine guidance, the right path that Allah leads believers to, and illumination that Allah gives to believers. Hudaayah is derived from the Arabic root H-D-Y, which conveys the meanings of guidance and illumination. In Islamic tradition, Hudaayah represents the role of Islam in guiding humanity, and it refers to Islam as the right path that leads to servitude and eternal life in paradise.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hudaayah holds great significance in Islamic culture as it symbolizes the idea of guidance. This name carries a sense of compassion and empathy towards others, as Hudaayah represents a person who helps others to find their way and navigate through their challenges in life. It serves as a reminder of the importance of kindness and cooperation within communities and families.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Hudaayah holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims. It embodies the concept of being a guiding light for others, reflecting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who was himself a source of guidance for his followers. The name Hudaayah also symbolizes the guidance and protection offered by Allah (God) to Muslims, who seek His guidance and follow His teachings in their daily lives. The name is a powerful reminder of the importance of being a source of light and knowledge for others, and striving to lead by example in the footsteps of the Prophet and Allah.
